title: Entropy Cache
description: A cache of supplies phases in and out of reality, left behind by a previous dimensional traveler who never made it back. The containers shimmer at their edges, half-dissolved by entropy, but their contents remain intact — frozen in the moment between existence and dissolution. Whoever left these knew this place well.

choices.label: Grab the supplies
choices.description: Snatch coins and trade goods from the cache before it phases out again.

choices.label: Collect the entropy residue
choices.description: Harvest the thick layer of entropy residue coating the cache's dissolving containers.

choices.label: Harvest the null fragments
choices.description: Break apart the null-space crystals forming where the cache meets empty reality.

choices.label: Leave it be
choices.description: Whatever happened to the last traveler, you would rather not share their fate.
